candidates.particulars: Name: Grace Minseo Han. Age: 34. Gender: female. Nationality: American. Race/ethnicity: Asian, specifically Korean American. Residence: Seattle, Washington. Gross household income: $148,000 annually; she lives alone, so this is also her own gross income. Partnership status: single and not currently partnered. Children status: none. Political identification: libertarian, with an emphasis on individual liberty and skepticism toward government restrictions in both social and economic life. Reading interest: enjoys reading for leisure, especially contemporary fiction and books about cities and design.
candidates.life_course: Grace grew up in the Seattle area in a Korean American family and studied information science at a public university. She now works as a product accessibility specialist at a mid-sized technology company, translating user feedback into practical changes. Her income is steady, but work can become deadline-heavy. After living with roommates in her twenties, she chose a small apartment of her own and values being able to set her own routines.
candidates.daily_life: She takes walks or uses a neighborhood gym before work when her calendar allows, cooks simple dinners, and keeps one or two evenings open for friends. She sees her parents and a younger cousin regularly without treating every family gathering as an obligation. Reading before bed helps her switch off from screens; she also borrows books from the library and trades recommendations with friends.
candidates.travel: Grace likes trips that combine a walkable city with access to green space: museums, cafes, neighborhood bookstores, and a day hike rather than a packed checklist. She often travels with a close friend, but is comfortable spending a few days alone if their schedules do not align. Her paid time off is adequate for one longer trip and a couple of shorter breaks, and she saves for travel while keeping an emergency cushion. On a past trip to Vancouver, she chose an extra unplanned day to explore on foot instead of squeezing in another booked activity. She is interested in future international travel, but has no particular destination or arrangement settled.
candidates.personality_and_voice: Grace is observant and direct without needing to dominate a conversation. She tends to ask how a plan will work in practice, and appreciates clear options more than polished persuasion. With friends she is playful and generous with recommendations; when tired, she becomes quieter and prefers a simple plan.

candidates.particulars: Name: Grace Minseo Han. Age: 46. Gender: female. Nationality: American. Race/ethnicity: Asian, specifically Korean American. Residence: Eugene, Oregon. Gross household income: $132,000 annually; she lives by herself, making this her household's sole income. Partnership status: single and not currently partnered. Children status: none. Political identification: libertarian, prioritizing individual liberty and expressing skepticism toward government restrictions in social and economic life. Reading interest: enjoys reading for leisure, including literary novels, memoirs, and nature writing.
candidates.life_course: Grace was raised in Northern California and moved to Oregon after college, where she studied landscape architecture. She now runs a small independent design practice, doing residential and community projects and occasionally collaborating with larger firms. Her earnings vary from year to year, but a recent run of steady work brought her household income into its current range. She rents a modest house alone and has built a professional life around choosing projects rather than pursuing a management track.
candidates.daily_life: A typical week mixes site visits, drawing and client calls, with errands she fits around daylight and weather. She tends a small garden, walks local trails, and meets two longtime friends for dinner or a board game when their schedules permit. She reads in the evening, often alternating a novel with nonfiction, and likes having quiet stretches without plans. She is close to her family but does not live near all of them.
candidates.travel: Grace prefers slower trips with a sense of place: a comfortable base, time outdoors, good local food, and room to change plans. She sometimes travels with a friend who enjoys walking, but will take a solo trip if no one can coordinate time off. As a self-employed person, she can sometimes extend a trip by shifting project work, though she must account for client deadlines and uneven income. On a past visit to Santa Fe, she chose several unstructured days of galleries and neighborhood wandering over a tightly scheduled regional tour. She would like to take another trip focused on landscape and architecture, but has not chosen where or when.
candidates.personality_and_voice: Grace is patient with complexity and tends to notice how spaces affect people. She is warm in small groups, but dislikes being hurried into decisions. Her humor is dry and understated; when discussing politics, she usually asks about practical consequences and personal choice rather than arguing from party labels.

candidates.particulars: Name: Grace Minseo Han. Age: 29. Gender: female. Nationality: American. Race/ethnicity: Asian, specifically Korean American. Residence: Sacramento, California. Gross household income: $116,000 annually; she lives alone, so the household income is her own gross income. Partnership status: single and not currently partnered. Children status: none. Political identification: libertarian, favoring individual liberty and skepticism toward government restrictions in both social and economic life. Reading interest: enjoys reading for leisure, particularly mysteries, essays, and accessible history.
candidates.life_course: Grace grew up in the Central Valley and earned a communications degree while working part-time. She is now a communications manager for a regional healthcare technology company. The role gives her a dependable salary and occasional busy periods around launches, but she has enough control to plan her time away with notice. She recently moved into a small apartment on her own after sharing with a friend; she is still furnishing it gradually rather than treating the move as a major lifestyle upgrade.
candidates.daily_life: She starts most workdays with coffee and a brief scan of the news, then spends much of the day writing, editing, and coordinating with colleagues. In the evenings she may cook, go to a local class, or meet a friend for a casual meal. She checks in with her parents and siblings by phone and enjoys being the aunt who visits, though she has no children of her own. A book and a quiet hour are her usual way to end the day.
candidates.travel: Grace likes trips that feel restorative but still offer plenty to explore: a museum or historic district, a food market, and a scenic walk, with a comfortable amount of downtime. She usually travels with a sibling or close friend and is willing to plan collaboratively, though she wants some independent time built in. Her job offers predictable blocks of leave, and she sets aside savings for one substantial trip alongside occasional nearby weekends. On a past trip to Chicago, she chose to stay longer in one neighborhood and revisit a bookstore and small museum rather than cross the city to follow a packed itinerary. She has ideas for a future overseas trip, but no destination is decided.
candidates.personality_and_voice: Grace is organized when other people depend on her, but relaxed about minor changes to her own plans. She listens carefully, then gives a candid opinion in plain language. She enjoys comparing options and asking what is actually included, while remaining comfortable leaving a decision for later.

candidates.particulars: Name: Grace Minseo Han. Age: 52. Gender: female. Nationality: American. Race/ethnicity: Asian, specifically Korean American. Residence: Anchorage, Alaska. Gross household income: $171,000 annually; she lives alone, making this her household's sole income. Partnership status: single and not currently partnered. Children status: none. Political identification: libertarian, prioritizing individual liberty and skepticism toward government restrictions in social and economic life. Reading interest: enjoys reading for leisure, especially historical novels, biographies, and travel writing.
candidates.life_course: Grace moved to Alaska in her thirties after studying computer networking in California. She now works in technical operations for a regional infrastructure company, where some weeks are routine and others require quick coordination when systems need attention. Her experience has made her financially comfortable, though she still plans around work coverage before taking extended leave. She lives alone and has close friends in Anchorage, along with siblings who live outside the state.
candidates.daily_life: On workdays she checks messages early, handles technical and planning tasks, and tries to protect evenings from becoming a second shift. She enjoys cooking for friends, walking when conditions suit her, and reading on quiet nights. She volunteers occasionally with a local community group but avoids filling every weekend. Calls with her siblings are a regular part of staying connected, and she often saves articles or books to discuss with them.
candidates.travel: Grace values trips that offer a clear change of pace: a few days in a city for food, museums, and bookstores, or a longer break with scenery and time outdoors. Because she works in a role that needs coverage, she prefers to arrange leave well ahead and may choose shorter trips when staffing is tight. She often travels with a sibling or longtime friend, but has also enjoyed being on her own. On a past visit to Seoul, she chose to spend extra time with relatives and explore nearby neighborhoods rather than rush through a list of major sights. She would like to travel more in the Pacific Northwest and revisit Korea, but has not made a future booking or selected a particular trip.
candidates.personality_and_voice: Grace is practical, self-reliant, and generally unflustered by logistical snags. She speaks thoughtfully and does not confuse confidence with certainty; if she lacks information, she says so. She enjoys lively conversation with people she trusts, but needs quiet time afterward and prefers invitations that leave room to decline.
